data.title: slop/: switch hardcoded /slop/*.png url() refs to relative now that build.js rewrites them

data.body: Discovered during FA-23. slop/style.css hardcodes root-absolute url('/slop/crowd.png'), '/slop/sign.png', '/slop/skyline.png' — the same bug FA-23 fixed for horse/: those resolve to nothing when the page is opened as a file:// URL, and only work when served from the domain root. FA-23 taught build.js to rewrite relative url() in site CSS to '<site>/...', so the fix is now a three-line change: use './crowd.png' etc. Verify with the WebKit snapshotter at /private/tmp/claude-503/-Users-forrest-Code-malls-github-io/7e5a1f85-446e-4042-9d3f-8829425f83cd/scratchpad/snap (./snap <url> <out.png> <w> <h>) on file:///Users/forrest/Code/malls.github.io/slop/index.html before and after, then rebuild. Note: slop/ was not in sites.config.json at the time of discovery but is now (10-site build).
